item.tib: shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa khams brgyad sdud pa'i don gsal bar byed pa'i 'grel pa
item.coloph: gzhung 'di nyid dang po ston pa nyid kyi zhal nas gsungs cing / bar du mkhas cing grub pa thob pa rnams la brgyud tshul ni rgyas par dang mthun par shes par bya'o/ tha mar dar cing dngos grub snyem pa'i tshul ni/ sprul sku gnyan mthing gis/ nyang stod rtsang po nu ma'i brag las thon nas byon pa'o/ de yang phyi nang gsang ba'i bon sde du ma drangs ba'i nang nas/ shes rab kyi bla med kyis bskor (kyi skor) yin no/ de la yang khams brgyad 'bum rtsa bsdud pa tshigs bcad 'bum tig dang / klu 'bum dkar po/ bang gong (pang kong) mchod pa chen po rnams so/ de la 'di ni bsdud pa tshigs bcad ma'o/ de nas dbus gtsang khams du (su) dar ba'o/ bsdus pa'i don la rgyas par rab phyes nas/ khams brgyad gsal ba'i 'grel 'di sbyar ba la/ gal te nyes pa'i skyon dag bsring (srid) gyur na/ rgyal dang rgyal sras mkhas pa'i tshogs la bshags/ dge tshogs dri med mthu ldan ji snyed des/ 'gro kun byang chub sa la bgrod par shog bdag kyang shes rab bla med sa thob nas/ 'gro ba 'dren cing phrin las rgyas bo bshog(par shog)gzhan yang shes rab bla med phyin spyod nas/ bsam don dge tshogs thams cad rab rgyas shog ces pa'i tshul 'di ni gshen gyi drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis bkra shis sman ri'i khrod du sbyar ba dge'o//
